### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_joined_teams` | List the teams the signed-in user is a member of, with their ids, names and descriptions. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_channels` | List the channels of a team, by its id from list\_joined\_teams, with each channel's id, name and membership type. filter takes OData, for example membershipType eq 'standard'. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_channel_messages` | Read the top-level messages of a channel, newest first, by team id and channel id. top is 1-50 (default 20); expand=replies includes each message's replies. Each message's id is the chatMessage-id that list\_replies and reply\_to\_channel\_message take; @odata.nextLink holds the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_replies` | Read the replies to one channel message, by team id, channel id and the message's id. top is 1-50. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_channel_message` | Read one channel message, by team id, channel id and the message's id, with its sender, body and reactions. | yes | no | auto |
| `post_channel_message` | Post a new message to a channel, by team id and channel id. The input body is the message, for example {"body": {"contentType": "text", "content": "Release 2.4 is out"}, "subject": "Release"}; subject is an optional headline. | no | no | ask |
| `reply_to_channel_message` | Reply to a channel message, by team id, channel id and the message's id. The input body is the reply, for example {"body": {"contentType": "text", "content": "On it."}}. | no | no | ask |
| `list_chats` | List the user's one-on-one, group and meeting chats, with their ids and topics. filter takes OData, for example chatType eq 'oneOnOne'; expand=members or expand=lastMessagePreview adds them; top is 1-50; @odata.nextLink holds the next page. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_chat_messages` | Read the messages of one chat, newest first, by its id from list\_chats. top is 1-50; orderby takes lastModifiedDateTime desc or createdDateTime desc; filter takes a date range, for example lastModifiedDateTime gt 2026-10-20T00:00:00Z. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_chat_members` | List the members of one chat, by its id from list\_chats, with their names, user ids and roles. | yes | no | auto |
| `send_chat_message` | Send a message in a chat, by its id. The input body is the message, for example {"body": {"contentType": "text", "content": "Can we move to 3pm?"}}. | no | no | ask |

### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fetch` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `entityUrls`. Read one or more Microsoft 365 entities by Graph resource path, such as /me/messages or /me/events/{event-id}. | yes | no | ask |
| `fetch_blob` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `path`. Read binary content by Graph resource path, such as a OneDrive file's content, returned as Base64. | yes | no | ask |
| `call_function` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `functionUrl`. Call a Microsoft Graph function by resource path, such as /me/calendarview with a time window. | yes | no | ask |
| `create_entity` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `parentUrl`, `jsonBody`. Create a Microsoft 365 entity in a collection, such as an event in /me/events. Blocked by tenant policy until an admin allows writes. | no | no | deny |
| `update_entity` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `entityUrl`, `jsonBody`. Change the fields of a Microsoft 365 entity by resource path. Blocked by tenant policy until an admin allows writes. | no | yes | deny |
| `delete_entity` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `entityUrl`. Delete a Microsoft 365 entity by resource path. Blocked by tenant policy until an admin allows writes. | no | yes | deny |
| `do_action` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `actionUrl`, `jsonBody`. Run a Microsoft Graph action by resource path, such as /me/messages/{message-id}/send. Blocked by tenant policy until an admin allows writes. | no | yes | deny |
| `ask` | Generic tool: per-tool policy sees only the verb; the operation is in `question`, `agentId`. Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot, or another agent by id, a question in natural language; billed in Copilot Credits. | no | no | deny |
| `list_agents` | List the Microsoft 365 Copilot agents the user can ask, with their ids and publishers. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_schema` | Return the JSON Schema or TypeScript definition of a Graph path or operation, for fetch, create or update. | yes | no | auto |
| `search_paths` | Find the Graph resource paths that match a prefix or a regular expression, such as messages. | yes | no | auto |
